title: Take: screen recordings that land already edited
excerpt: Native Mac screen recorder with automatic staging and live editing. Now with a live stage: your staged screen as a camera in Meet, Zoom and FaceTime. $24.99 once.
content_html:
Take · for macOS

Stop the recording and it is already staged: a real backdrop, rounded corners, a cursor that glides instead of jitters, and zooms placed where you actually clicked. Then change any of it live, on a timeline, and watch the canvas follow. The Screen Studio class, native, offline, and bought once. And new in 2.1: the same staged screen can go out live, as a camera that Meet, Zoom and FaceTime can pick.

No card for the trial · no watermark, ever · macOS 14 Sonoma or later, universal · signed and notarized

75 seconds: record, edit live, then go on air with the same staged screen. Drawn from the real interface.

Real screenshot of the Take editor. Every zoom on that timeline is an object you can drag, retime or delete, and the frame on the canvas came out of the same compositor that writes the exported file.

TRY IT

Edit live. Render once.

Scrub the timeline, drop a zoom in, turn the face bubble on. The frame changes as you go, because the thing drawing this preview is the thing that writes the file. There is no apply step and no waiting.

The staging

Every capture lands finished.

Take records the screen and, separately, the truth about what happened on it: where the cursor went, when you clicked, which window moved. The staging is solved from that, which is why it can stay editable instead of being baked into pixels.

The backdrop

Padding, rounded corners and a true shadow, over a backdrop you pick. Set padding to zero and it fills the frame edge to edge. Save the look you like as the default and every future take arrives wearing it.

The cursor

Redrawn from its own track rather than filmed, so it stays crisp at 2.4x zoom. Spring-smoothed, resizable, with hide-when-idle and a spotlight that dims everything but the pointer.

The zooms

Solved from click clusters, then handed to you as clips on a timeline. Drag one to move it, tap the empty row to add one, delete the one that guessed wrong.

The editing

Objects, not renders.

Most recorders make you commit: apply the edit, wait for a render, watch it back, undo, wait again. Take runs one compositor for both the live canvas and the exported file, so the thing you are scrubbing IS the thing you will ship.

  • Preview equals export. Not approximately. The same code path draws both.
  • Blur what should not ship. Drag a box over a key or a customer name. It rides the timeline and burns into the file.
  • Keystrokes as keycaps. Shortcuts appear as you press them, so a terminal demo does not need narration to be followable.
  • Dead air speeds up, it does not vanish. Idle spans get a 4x ramp by default, and you can keep any of them at full speed.

Real render from the shipping compositor.

Made for demos

The details that decide whether people watch.

Click rings and motion blur

A ring where you clicked and a real motion blur on fast pans, so a viewer's eye follows the action instead of losing it.

Camera bubble

A live circular camera you can drag anywhere or pin to a corner, recorded separately and composited at export. Off by default, because most demos do not want a face.

iPhone, in a real frame

Record a cabled iPhone inside its actual device bezel, no mockup afterwards.

9:16 without cropping badly

Reframe a take to vertical and the zooms are re-solved for the new shape rather than sliced down the middle.

Captions, on device

Transcribed by macOS on your Mac and burned in if you want them. No upload, no per-minute bill.

Exports that tell the truth

MP4, ProRes, animated GIF and raw passthrough, each showing a real size estimate before you commit to it.

New in 2.1 · The live stage

Your staged screen, live in the meeting.

Everything Take does to a recording, it can now do to a call. Open the Live Studio, go live, and every video app on your Mac gains a camera named Take Camera. Pick it in Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or OBS and the call sees what the studio monitor shows: your screen on its backdrop, your face in the bubble, zooms following your clicks.

  • Scenes on hotkeys. Your screen, full screen, a be right back card, a title and an ending ship ready. Control command 1 through 9 switches with a smooth dissolve, or instantly with option held.
  • One click, mid-presentation. The bubble and the zoom have switches on the studio bar and on a floating bar that stays over any app. Hide your face or park the zoom without touching a menu while people watch.
  • Record what went out. A separate Record button saves a take of the exact frames the stream carried, on the same clock. It lands in your library and edits like any other take.
  • Honest under load. If your Mac falls behind, Take steps down loudly, one rung at a time, and tells you in a sentence. It never silently degrades your stream.

Install the camera once from the studio, approve it once in System Settings, and it is there for every app. There is a remove button right beside install, because a camera you cannot uninstall is not yours. Your self view in Meet or FaceTime appears mirrored, the way those apps show every camera; everyone else sees it the right way round.

The comparison

Take vs the rest.

Take is not alone on any single row. It is the only one that lands every row at once: a one-time, native, offline recorder that stages your captures and edits them live.

Pricing

Pay by card or crypto. Everything you own lives at your account. What changed in the last release

Questions

Good to know.

Can I try Take before I buy?

Yes. Take runs fully for 7 days with no card. Make an account, confirm your email, and the download starts. Nothing is watermarked during the trial or after it.

Does Take work offline?

Yes. You need internet once to activate. Recording, staging, editing and exporting all run on your Mac using Core Image and Metal. Nothing you record is uploaded anywhere.

What format are the files, and is there a watermark?

Takes are ordinary .mov files in an open folder, with a small sidecar next to each one holding the edits. There is no watermark, ever, and no proprietary project format to export out of.

Which Macs does Take run on?

Any Mac on macOS 14 Sonoma or later. The app is universal, so Apple Silicon and Intel both run natively.

Can Take present live in Google Meet or Zoom?

Yes. Open the Live Studio, go live, and pick the camera named Take Camera in Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or OBS. The call sees your staged screen: backdrop, camera bubble, zooms and scene switches, exactly what the studio monitor shows. Install the camera once from the studio and approve it once in System Settings.

How does Take compare to Screen Studio?

Take matches it on automatic staging and adds live editing, where moving a zoom updates the canvas immediately because the preview and the export use the same compositor. Take also presents live through a virtual camera, which Screen Studio does not do. Screen Studio is subscription-only for new buyers and project-based; Take is one payment and plain files.

How do updates work?

Take checks for updates by itself and can install them in place, and there is a Check for updates button in Settings if you would rather ask. Every update is free.

Record once. Ship the demo.

Seven days, no card, no watermark. If it does not beat what you use now, you have lost nothing.

content_html_zh:
以 macOS 为例

停止录制，它已经上演了：真实的背景、圆角、滑动而不是抖动的光标，以及放置在您实际单击的位置的缩放。 然后在时间轴上实时更改其中的任何一个，并观察画布的变化。 Screen Studio 课程，原生，离线，买过一次。 2.1 中的新功能：同一个舞台屏幕可以实时显示，就像 Meet、Zoom 和 FaceTime 可以选择的摄像头一样。

无试用卡 · 永远没有水印 · macOS 14 Sonoma 或更高版本，通用 · 签名并公证

75 秒：录制、现场编辑，然后在相同的舞台屏幕上播出。 取自真实界面。

Take 编辑器的真实截图。 该时间线上的每个缩放都是一个可以拖动、重新定时或删除的对象，画布上的帧来自写入导出文件的同一合成器。

TRY IT

实时编辑。 渲染一次。

滑动时间线，放大，打开脸部气泡。 框架会随着您的移动而变化，因为绘制此预览的东西就是写入文件的东西。 没有申请步骤，也无需等待。

分期

每一个占领地都完成了。

Take 记录了屏幕，并分别记录了屏幕上发生的事情的真相：光标去了哪里、何时单击、哪个窗口移动了。 舞台由此解决，这就是为什么它可以保持可编辑而不是被烘焙成像素。

背景

在您选择的背景上填充、圆角和真实的阴影。 将填充设置为零，它会边缘到边缘填充框架。 将您喜欢的外观保存为默认外观，以后每次拍摄时都会穿着它。

光标

根据自己的轨道重新绘制而不是拍摄，因此它在 2.4 倍变焦时保持清晰。 弹簧平滑、可调整大小、空闲时隐藏以及聚光灯可以使除指针以外的所有内容变暗。

变焦

通过点击簇解决，然后作为时间轴上的剪辑交给您。 拖动一项来移动它，点击空行来添加一项，删除猜错的一项。

编辑

对象，而不是渲染。

大多数录音机都会让您提交：应用编辑、等待渲染、回放、撤消、再次等待。 Take 为实时画布和导出的文件运行一个合成器，因此您正在擦除的内容就是您将要发送的内容。

  • 预览等于导出。 大约不是。 相同的代码路径绘制了两者。
  • 模糊不应该发货的内容。 将一个框拖到密钥或客户名称上。 它沿着时间线并刻录到文件中。
  • 按键作为键帽。 当您按下快捷方式时就会出现，因此终端演示不需要旁白即可跟随。
  • 死气加速，但并没有消失。 默认情况下，空闲跨度获得 4 倍坡度，并且您可以将其中任何一个保持全速。

来自运输合成器的真实渲染。

专为演示而设计

细节决定人们是否观看。

点击环和运动模糊

单击时的环和快速平移时的真实运动模糊，因此观看者的眼睛会跟随动作而不是失去它。

相机气泡

您可以将实时圆形摄像机拖动到任何地方或固定到角落，单独录制并在导出时合成。 默认关闭，因为大多数演示不需要面孔。

iPhone，在真实的相框中

将有线 iPhone 记录在其实际设备边框内，之后不再制作模型。

9:16 没有严重裁剪

将镜头重新构图为垂直，并针对新形状重新解决缩放问题，而不是从中间切分。

设备上的字幕

由 Mac 上的 macOS 转录并刻录（如果您需要）。 无需上传，无需按分钟计费。

出口说实话

MP4、ProRes、动画 GIF 和原始直通，每种都在您提交之前显示实际大小估计。

2.1新内容·现场舞台

问题

很高兴知道。

Can I try Take before I buy?

是的。 全程无卡运行 7 天。 注册一个帐户，确认您的电子邮件，然后开始下载。 试用期间或试用后没有任何内容被加水印。

Does Take work offline?

是的。 您需要一次互联网才能激活。 录制、登台、编辑和导出都可以使用 Core Image 和 Metal 在 Mac 上运行。 您录制的任何内容都不会上传到任何地方。

What format are the files, and is there a watermark?

镜头是打开文件夹中的普通 .mov 文件，每个文件旁边都有一个小 sidecar 保存编辑内容。 永远没有水印，也没有可供导出的专有项目格式。

Which Macs does Take run on?

任何运行 macOS 14 Sonoma 或更高版本的 Mac。 该应用程序是通用的，因此 Apple Silicon 和 Intel 都可以在本机运行。

Can Take present live in Google Meet or Zoom?

是的。 打开 Live Studio，开始直播，然后在 Meet、Zoom、FaceTime 或 OBS 中选择名为“拍摄相机”的摄像头。 通话中会看到您的舞台屏幕：背景、摄像头气泡、变焦和场景切换，与演播室监视器所显示的完全一样。 从工作室安装一次相机并在系统设置中批准一次。

How does Take compare to Screen Studio?

在自动登台上进行匹配并添加实时编辑，其中移动缩放会立即更新画布，因为预览和导出使用相同的合成器。 Take 还通过虚拟摄像机进行现场演示，而 Screen Studio 则不这样做。 Screen Studio 仅限新买家订阅且基于项目；采取的是一次付款和纯文件。

How do updates work?

自行检查更新并可以就地安装它们，如果您愿意的话，“设置”中有一个“检查更新”按钮。 每次更新都是免费的。
